# Apply Fixes

## Change Summary

Added backward-compatible algae half-saturation normalization on both save-load and process-preset parse paths. Legacy `algae_half_saturation_*_mg_total` save payloads now migrate/normalize to concentration units, current-schema save payloads still accept the legacy keys, process preset parsing converts the old TOML keys and matching `param_meta` entries to canonical concentration-based names, and regression coverage was added for the legacy save and preset cases.

## Steps

1. [Completed] Inspected the save migration chain and process preset parser to locate where legacy algae half-saturation aliases were still deserializing with the wrong semantics.
2. [Completed] Implemented algae half-saturation compatibility handling in save loading so legacy `*_mg_total` values are converted to concentration units during migration and before current-schema deserialization.
3. [Completed] Extended process preset parsing to convert legacy algae TOML keys and corresponding `param_meta` entries, and added regression tests for legacy save and preset inputs.
4. [Completed] Formatted the workspace and ran focused validation for the new compatibility paths, plus broader package tests where feasible.

## Validation Evidence

- `cargo fmt --all` completed successfully.
- `cargo test -p tank_data --lib` passed (31 tests).
- `cargo test -p tank_core --test save_load legacy_schema_v8_saves_convert_algae_half_saturation_totals_to_concentrations -- --exact` passed.
- `cargo test -p tank_core --test save_load current_schema_payloads_accept_legacy_algae_half_saturation_keys -- --exact` passed.
- Attempted `cargo test -p tank_core --test save_load`; the suite still fails in pre-existing non-algae roundtrip/determinism tests (`save_load_roundtrip`, `save_load_with_source_water_catalog`, `save_load_with_active_cycle_state`).

## Outstanding Risks

- `cargo test -p tank_core --test save_load` still has unrelated existing failures in `save_load_roundtrip`, `save_load_with_source_water_catalog`, and `save_load_with_active_cycle_state`; the new algae compatibility regressions were validated with exact-test runs instead.
- The prior-stage checkpoint/summary mismatch called out in review was not corrected here; that remains a process/audit artifact outside the code changes validated in this run.
